line.a_domek.text: Look, there's a house up in the tree! I'd love to climb up and see the whole forest from above.

line.a_kto.text: The lowest branch is high up. Which of us is the tallest and can reach it?

line.a_najwyzsza.text: Me! I'm standing on a stump, so now I'm the tallest!

line.a_nie_siegam.text: Oh no, I can't reach. I was higher up, and I'm still too short.

line.a_metoda.text: The stump only lifted you up. To check who is tall and who is short, we must stand on the same ground.

line.a_wszyscy.text: Let's all stand on one line, on the same ground. I'll draw a line over every head.

line.a_najwyzszy.text: Point to the tallest of us.

line.a_najwyzszy_nie.text: Look at our heads. Whose is the highest?

line.a_ja.text: I'm the tallest! I can reach the branch.

line.a_najnizszy.text: And now point to the shortest of us.

line.a_najnizszy_nie.text: Look at our heads. Whose is the lowest?

line.a_ja_najnizsza.text: That's me! I'm the shortest, but I climb trees the fastest.

line.b_drabina.text: Oh dear, the ladder to the treehouse is broken. We need a tall stick.

line.b_postaw.text: Drag both sticks onto the line, so they stand on the same ground.

line.b_ktory_nie.text: This stick is shorter. Point to the one that reaches higher.

line.b_mam.text: I've got a tall stick! I'll mend the ladder. Let's go into the treehouse!

line.b_jez.text: Hello! I'd like to pick an apple, but I'm very short.

line.b_najnizsze.text: Hedgehog can only reach the shortest tree. Point to the shortest tree.

line.b_najnizsze_nie.text: That tree is too tall for Hedgehog. Look for the shortest one.

line.b_dziekuje.text: The shortest tree! I reached it. Thank you!

line.p_start.text: Let's play tall and short! I have five games.

line.p_wyzsza_nie.text: This candle is shorter. Point to the taller one.

line.p_na_ziemi.text: One sunflower is higher up, but is it taller? Stand both on the line.

line.p_ktory_nie.text: This one is shorter. Point to the taller sunflower.

line.p_najnizszy_nie.text: This stick is taller. Look for the shortest one.

line.p_cien.text: Point to the tree this shadow belongs to: the tall one or the short one?

line.p_cien_nie.text: Look at the shadow again. Is it tall or short?

line.p_kto.text: Now us! Point to the shortest of us.

line.p_kto_nie.text: Look at our heads. Whose is the lowest?

line.p_kto_ok.text: That's me, Hedgehog! I'm the shortest.

line.d_miarka.text: There's a height chart in the hallway. Everyone stands by it, and I draw a line over their head.

line.d_najwyzszy.text: Look at the lines on the chart. Point to the highest line.

line.d_nie.text: Look whose line is the highest and whose is the lowest.

line.d_nie.mis.text: Look whose line is the highest and whose is the lowest.

line.d_nie.wiewiorka.text: Look whose line is the highest and whose is the lowest.

line.d_rosne.text: I'm the shortest, but I'm still growing. Next year my line will be higher!

line.d_rodzice.text: Measure yourself by the door with your parents and mark a line. Who at home is the tallest, and who is the shortest?

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for helping with the treehouse! Here is a sticker for your album, as a keepsake. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is Bear's treehouse. We got it when we compared who is tall and who is short.

line.d_nie.jez.text: Look whose line is the highest and whose is the lowest.

line.c_skrzynia.text: Oh, there's an old chest in the treehouse!

line.c_klucz.text: Up there, at the very top, on the peg! Hop, hop... I can't reach.

line.c_kto.text: The key hangs very high. The tallest of us will take it down. Point to who that is.

line.c_kto_nie.text: Look at our heads. Whose is the highest?

line.c_zdejmuje.text: I'm the tallest, I can reach! I'm taking the key down.

line.c_luneta.text: There's a spyglass in the chest! A real spyglass!

line.c_patrze.text: Let's look through the spyglass at the orchard below.

line.c_myszki.text: Some mice are hiding in the orchard. Point to every mouse and find them all!

line.c_jezyk.text: And over there in the orchard Hedgehog is waving to us. Let's go to him!

line.d_jez_ksiazki.text: I'll stand on books! Then I'll be taller than Squirrel!

line.d_zabierz.text: Hedgehog, the books only lift you up! That's not how we measure.

line.d_na_podlodze.text: Now Hedgehog stands on the floor, like everyone. I'm drawing his line.

line.d_kto_wyzszy.text: Point to who is taller: Fox or Squirrel.

line.b_chowany.text: And now let's play hide and seek! Bear, you look for us, and we'll hide in the bushes.

line.b_zasady.text: All right! Whoever is hiding will call: peekaboo! And you will point to the bush the voice came from.

line.b_smutno.text: Too bad I'm so short. I can't climb the ladder to the treehouse, and I'll never see the forest from above.

line.b_obiecuje.text: Come home with us, Hedgehog. I'll think of something, I promise!

line.c_okno.text: We're in the treehouse! Quick, to the window!

line.c_las.text: I can see the whole forest from above! It's so high up here! And down below there's an orchard with apple trees.

line.p_ktory_ok.text: Yes, this sunflower is taller! The other one was only standing higher up.

line.p_cien_wysokie.text: Yes, it's the tall tree's shadow!

line.p_cien_niskie.text: Yes, it's the short tree's shadow!

line.d_najwyzszy_ok.text: Yes, that's my line! I'm the tallest of us.

line.d_wyzszy_ok.text: Yes, I'm taller than Squirrel, and Squirrel is shorter than me.

line.d_powrot.text: We're home! Hedgehog came with us, and I brought the spyglass from the treehouse.

line.d_powies.text: Hang the spyglass high on the hooks, so it doesn't get lost. Drag it onto a hook.

line.d_odloz.text: Put the books on the shelf of the shoe rack, so Hedgehog stands on the floor.

line.d_smutno.text: I'm the shortest. I'll never see the forest from above like Bear did.

line.d_ramiona.text: You will! I'm the tallest, so I'll take the spyglass off the hook. Now climb up on my shoulders!

line.d_widze.text: I can see the whole forest! Now I'm the highest of all.

line.d_ale.text: The highest, but not the tallest! Bear lifted you up.

line.b_stoja.text: Now both sticks stand on the same ground. You can see the difference at once!

line.p_stoja.text: Now both sunflowers stand on the line, on the same ground.

line.c_widze_sad.text: I'm looking through the spyglass... I can see the orchard below the treehouse!
